doc: A whole project in one buffer: each book's key and its dish, framed, not re-encoded.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: FORMAT_VERSION, independent of the version each dish carries.

envelope.doc: One book's key and dish, by position and length.

fields.name: keyLen
fields.doc: Its bytes of UTF-8, carried verbatim and never parsed.

fields.name: dishAt
fields.doc: Where the book's dish starts; 4-aligned so its sections can be viewed in place.

fields.name: dishLen
fields.doc: Its bytes: exactly what `onion::wire::plate` wrote for the book.

envelope.doc: Whatever the caller identifies the book by, padded to 4.
The book's dish, unchanged, padded to 4.
